seo.title: Earthquake tracker: recent earthquakes near the Philippines
seo.description: See recent earthquakes near the Philippines and around the world on a map and in a list. Data from USGS, GeoNet and BMKG. Yanig checks for new data every 10 minutes.

hero.title: Earthquake tracker
hero.intro: See recent earthquakes near the Philippines and around the world. Select an earthquake in the list to show it on the map.
